newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: FIGURE SKATING-KWAN STILL WELL BELOW BEST.
newsitem.headline: FIGURE SKATING-KWAN STILL WELL BELOW BEST.

text.p: World champion Michelle Kwan is still searching for the elusive sparkle and consistency that made her seem invincible until a month ago.

Though she won her qualifying group at the world championships on Monday, the 16-year-old titleholder was once more well below her best, just as she was when she lost her national title and the Championship Series final to team mate Tara Lipinski over the past month.
The 16-year-old American won group A of the qualifying from Vanessa Gusmeroli of France with European champion Irina Slutskaya of Russia third.
Lipinski, third American Nicole Bobek and Chen Lu of China were in the second group later in the day.

Kwan at least had the satisfaction of staying on her feet for the first time since the short programme of last month's national championships. She fell in the long programme there and in both sections of the Champions Series final.

But her opening jump combination of triple lutz-triple toe loop was scaled down to triple-double, she doubled out of a planned triple flip and did only a single Axel where she planned a double late in her routine.
"I kind of chickened out of a couple of jumps," she said, adding that she was trying to change her focus.
"I think I've learned a lesson from the last two events. I went in saying 'Oh my God, this is a Nationals, Oh my God this is the Champions Series'
"Now I'm trying to forget what the competition is and just focus on my skating.
"I'm trying to get my mental edge back and get my head stronger."
Kwan won last year's title in magnificent form and continued superbly right through this season until a fall during Nationals produced a bout of what she termed was panic.
She seems not yet to have reocvered.
"I'm trying to focus on what I'm here for and have tunnel vision on whay I'm trying to accomplish," she said.
"I'm trying to see beyond just my skates and my blades on the ice, but right now I have to concentrate on those things."
Gusmeroli skated a fine routine to circus music but Slutskaya, like Kwan, was disappointing, failing to do what she intended with her first two jumps
